children.text: We transcend the conventional boundaries of recruiters, bringing a pragmatic and expert approach to talent sourcing. We implement proven scalable methodologies that allow us to identify and place candidates 70% faster than industry average.

XcelCareers (XC), LLC has sourced and placed over 600+ Cyber Security, Systems Engineers, DevOps, Developers, and multiple Technical and Non Technical positions throughout the DOD, Intelligence Community, and other government agencies. As a minority veteran-owned small business XC prides itself in providing staffing solutions to both government and private entities. With a combined 20+ years of experience, XC has the capabilities, resources, and competencies to deliver high-quality candidates with niche skill sets.
Rapid Task Order, IDIQ, and Proposal Staffing
A.I. Tools for global market data research
Staffing Matrix Development and Compliance Support
Fulfilling of Hard to Recruit Positions (i.e. job postings that have not been filled in 30+ days)
General Dynamics (Huntsville, AL, 2017) Placed MBSE Engineers (Model-Based Systems Engineering) Dallas, West VA
Indeed (2022) Provided market data research for 2 A.I. Ethics Data Scientists in San Francisco, 3 Machine Learning Engineers for New York, NY, and 4 Austin, TX

Northrop Grumman (Falls Church, Virginia, Current) Support Codex contract submitting Cyber Security engineers with Cloud Software Development experience. Have currently placed 8 with security clearance.
